Problem Statement:
Your old mobile phone gets broken and so you want to purchase a new smartphone and decide to go through all the online websites to find out which dealer has the best offer for a particular model. You document the prices of N dealers. Dealer ids start from 0 and go up to N. Find out which dealer has the best price for you. Constraints: 1 <= N <= 100 1 <= A[] <= 100000 
Input Description:
Number of dealers followed by the price offered by each dealer 
Output Description:
Dealer offering the best price. 
Sample Input:
3
10000 11200 12030 
Sample Output:
Dealer0 
Explanation:
Dealer0 offers the lowest price of 10000.
